creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`corpus/conformance/layout-export.json` declares `source: recorded` and `regenerate: tools/herdr-probe/probe layout`. Running that command fails two tests.

`corpus/herdr-0.8.0/layout/wire.ndjson` is five concatenated runs, one of them from a scenario order that no longer exists - the recorder's own docstring names that accumulation as a bug it has since fixed, so the checked-in file predates the fix. Three `layout-export.json` cases are pinned to lines only that stale run contains.

Concretely: "a divider drag answers with the arrangement it settled on" is the five-pane tree with the root at 0.3, but the scenario now drags after the same-axis split that adds w1:p6, so the answer is a six-pane tree. `dragged-layout.export.json` has held the six-pane shape for a while, so the artifacts already disagree with the case. "sixteen panes at every depth the recording reached" is stale the same way.

`the_two_readers_describe_the_same_tab_the_same_way` is what makes it more than a re-derivation: it requires the drag's answer and the deep rects to be one tab arrangement differing only in the root ratio. Restoring that means either moving the drag before the same-axis split, or re-deriving all three cases and rewriting what that test pairs.

Found while adding the layout-replay scenario (a_27WZ30MO1). Left alone deliberately: it is a spec decision about someone else's concept, and the fix wants to be one commit that is about this.
title: 🧪 Re-recording the layout scenario turns the suite red
